A '''bathysphere''' was a vessel used to travel deep [[Water/Legends|underwater]],<ref name="DU" /> and also within the dense [[Gravity/Legends|gravitic]] layers of a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]].<ref name="RPG" /> Aquatic bathyspheres were used extensively on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]].<ref name="DU" /> The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] once crossed paths with the crew of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-controlled [[Unidentified bathysphere|bathysphere]]. He was forced to form a temporary truce with [[Unidentified Imperial (bathysphere)|one of the Imperials]] when the damaged craft plummeted below the [[Cloud/Legends|cloud]] layer of a [[Unidentified Jovian planet|Jovian gas giant]]. The Imperial and Garnet respectively steadied the vessel's descent and repaired its [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsors]] before engaging in a [[Lightfight|firefight]].<ref name="RPG" />
